name: Ammeter (shunt burden)
description: Insert in series. The shunt resistance develops a burden voltage and reduces the current being measured; + to - is positive current.

shunt_resistance.doc: Total insertion resistance, including the shunt and leads; voltage drop = current × resistance.

outputs.name: voltage
outputs.doc: Signed terminal voltage V(+) − V(-); ammeter burden voltage.

outputs.name: current
outputs.doc: Total current entering +, including displacement current for a capacitive input.

electrical.claims: Finite linear resistance; signed terminal voltage and current observations.
omissions: Manufacturer-specific ranges, accuracy, noise and calibration
Overload protection, fuse failure, heating and damage
Common-mode limits and an earth/chassis connection; reference lead must be wired explicitly

sources.title: Tektronix: ABCs of Probes Primer
sources.notes: Input loading and equivalent-circuit background. All instrument defaults are representative and configurable; no manufacturer-specific qualification is claimed. The generator uses an explicitly defined Thevenin model.
